resolution.note: py rows failed because a finished outside-acceptance invocation wiped the shared scratch runs directory under a concurrent row (vanished worktree, missing upstream clone); each invocation now sweeps only its own row directories, and a failed row names its --repo repository

title: Outside py rows drain again: the baseline ignores KRN worktrees on the real receiver and the bug row keeps its repository
body:
Why: outside rerun 1115j on KRN afa601c (after t-6k4p11d 40d3803): (1) py plain still drains exit 72 with the same red baseline `.venv/bin/python -m pytest fails on a clean origin/outside/py (exit 1: FileNotFoundError: ... /runs/py-1794754859105/.krn/worktrees/t-0x3pmx6)` (.krn/runs/clause-proof/py-1115j.log:642) — t-6k4p11d's preflight fix did not bite on the real receiver; (2) py bug row regressed vs 1115i (merged bc25be7, hidden 13/13): now it stops before adopt with `outside-acceptance: py: tests/test_unzip_http.py not in the fix` and the row prints repository `krn-works/krn` although `--repo py=krn-works/outside-py` was passed (.krn/runs/clause-proof/py-1115j-bug.log line 1).
Commands: `node scripts/outside-acceptance.ts --stack py --repo py=krn-works/outside-py --scratch /mnt/storage/tmp/krn-outside --window-hours 2` and the same with `--task-file scripts/outside-hidden/tasks.json`.
Outcome: py plain drains past preflight; py bug row adopts and drains as in 1115i, against krn-works/outside-py.
Proof: reproduce each on the real receiver first (the lane may run the py rows itself for this task), regression tests red before the fix at the lowest layer, then a py plain and py bug row both reach drain exit 0.
